{{nihongo|'''Mishima Shrine'''|箕島神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Ōmi Province]].

'''Mishima Shrine''' (みしまじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Takashima, Shiga|ar|تاكاشيما (شيغا)|azb|تاکاشیما، شیقا|ce|Такасима|ceb|Takashima|de|Takashima (Shiga)|eo|Takaŝima|es|Takashima (Shiga)|fa|تاکاشیما، شیگا|fi|Takashima|fr|Takashima|gl|Takashima|id|Takashima, Shiga|it|Takashima|ja|高島市|ko|다카시마시|mzn|تاکاشیما، شیگا|nl|Takashima|pl|Takashima|pt|Takashima (Shiga)|ro|Takashima, Shiga|ru|Такасима|sv|Takashima|tg|Такашима|th|ทากาชิมะ|tl|Takashima, Shiga|tr|Takashima|tt|Такасима|uk|Такасіма (Сіґа)|ur|ٹاکاشیما، شیگا|vi|Takashima, Shiga|war|Takashima, Shiga|zh|高島市|zh_classical|高島市|zh_min_nan|Takasima-chhī|zh_yue|高島|qid=Q845794}}, {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|Q131358|qid=Q131358}}. It is identified as the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} Mishima Shrine (みしまじんじゃ)<ref name=特選神名牒>[https://dl.ndl.go.jp/pid/971155/1/243 特選神名牒]</ref>.

Its records were lost in a fire, so the founding history is unknown<ref>『高島郡誌』141p</ref>. However, it is identified with Mishima Shrine of {{ill|Takashima District, Shiga|fa|بخش تاکاشیما، شیگا|ja|高島郡 (滋賀県)|zh|高島郡 (滋賀縣)|qid=Q11669692|lt=Takashima District}}, a Shikinaisha<ref name=特選神名牒/>, so it must have been founded before {{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}, when the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} was compiled.

Because "Mishima" (written 箕島) is a homophone of "Mishima" (三島), and it is commonly called Mishima Myōjin<ref name=特選神名牒/>, it is also regarded as related to {{ill|Mishima–Ōyamazumi cult|ja|三島・大山祇信仰|qid=Q127948103}} and assigned {{ill|Ōyamatsumi|lt=Ōyamatsumi|Q386563|qid=Q386563|qid=Q386563|lt=Ōyamatsumi-no-Kami}}. In other cases, the deity is also given as {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi|Q8009611|qid=Q8009611|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Kami}} or {{ill|Ama no Kantama no Mikoto|Q135271288|qid=Q135271288}}.

=== Enshrined deity ===
; Principal enshrined deity
* {{ill|Ōyamatsumi|lt=Ōyamatsumi|Q386563|qid=Q386563|qid=Q386563|lt=Ōyamatsumi-no-Kami}} (according to the Shikinaisha investigation report, ''Shiga-ken Jinja-shi'', Shiga Prefectural Shrine Office, shrine registers, and ''Takashima-gunshi'')
; Auxiliary shrine
* Musubi Shrine
